expected: Generate/queue cancellation and transport loss; next turn valid; no false completion or duplicate side effects.
limitations: Workaround: run `restart` after cancelling queued work; OMP itself never queues its own requests (maxInFlightRequests 1), so the trigger needs a second concurrent client.
observed: Client loss while generating: the server stops within 63-80 ms (finish disconnect) and the next turn is valid. A completed side effect followed by client loss is not repeated on resume (1 execution, 1 log line). A failed tool is followed by a valid turn. Queue cancellation is NOT safe: when a client disconnects while its request is queued behind another, the next request with a multi-chunk prompt fails with HTTP 400 'cancelled', the engine process exits (code 1), the following request gets HTTP 503, and only then does Strata restart the engine (~15 s). Reproduced 2/2 by the minimal g14q probe; the control (the generating client disconnects, nothing queued) stayed clean. Short prompts in between succeed, which is why attempt 2's five short follow-ups passed while the next OMP turn (G15 attempt 2) failed. No false completion was observed: every failed turn ended as an explicit error.
reason: Stock Strata v0.1.27 stale-cancel defect: a queued client's disconnect poisons the next long-prompt request and crashes the engine; recovery is automatic after two failed requests or immediate with `restart`.

retry_history.reason: Queue-cancel case ran before the side-effect case; the next OMP turn failed with engine 'cancelled' and the engine restarted (first sighting of the defect).
Reordered probe: all sub-cases passed with five short follow-up requests, but the next long-prompt OMP turn (G15 attempt 2) failed the same way; the probe was too weak.
